name: vue3-mpa
title: Vue 3 Multi-Page (MPA)
description: A Vue 3 + Vite multi-page application driven by project.config.ts, @lhx-kit/vite-plugin, and the @lhx-kit/renderer. Ships Biome + husky + commitlint + lint-staged + vitest + playwright + Pinia + MSW. UI library, target (PC/mobile/hybrid) and CSS solution are scaffold-time features. Add `--features=offline` for hybrid WebView packaging.
